The '''DL-51''' was a model of blaster pistol used in the years following the [[Second Galactic Civil War]]. [[Taryn Zel]] armed herself with two of them when participating in the [[Raid on Detention Center 81|mission]] to recover [[Valin Horn|Valin]] and [[Jysella Horn]].
